name: qoder-credits-inspector
description: Visualize the current session's token consumption — billed input total, context usage, resend amplification, and per-category / per-tool / per-file (path-level) breakdown — as a Canvas report that refreshes automatically every time the Agent stops.
descriptionZh: 图形化展示当前会话的 token 消耗：计费输入总量、上下文占用、重发放大，以及按类别 / 工具 / 文件（精确到路径）的占比明细，以 Canvas 报告呈现，并在 Agent 每次结束响应时自动刷新。
